hero.bodyLeft: A design and technology studio for products, brands, and systems that need clarity before execution.
hero.bodyRight: We help teams shape vague ideas into well-defined work, then design interfaces, build software, and engineer onchain systems with precision.
services.label: Services
services.lead: We like projects with a clear purpose and long‑term value.
services.01.title: Smart Contract Development
services.01.desc: EVM contracts written with intent: tight specs, predictable gas, full test coverage. Tokens, vaults, governance, custom protocol logic.
services.02.title: Smart Contract Audits
services.02.desc: Independent security reviews for Solidity and Vyper. Threat models, invariant tests, written reports you can hand to investors and users.
services.03.title: Web App Development
services.03.desc: Production web applications with clean architecture. From first prototype to codebases that survive scale and hand‑offs.
services.04.title: Web Design
services.04.desc: Sites that read clearly and load fast. Calm layouts, considered typography, attention to the surfaces people actually touch.
services.05.title: Digital Product Design
services.05.desc: Interfaces designed end‑to‑end: research, flows, components, prototypes. Built so engineering can ship without guessing.
services.06.title: Brand & Visual Identity
services.06.desc: Names, marks, type systems, tone of voice. Identity systems with a quiet confidence, ready for product surfaces.
services.07.title: Graphics & Digital Art
services.07.desc: Original illustration, motion pieces, generative work. Visual systems with a point of view, not stock‑feeling filler.
services.08.title: Technical Advisory
services.08.desc: Architecture reviews, Web3 integration strategy, technology decisions. Honest trade‑offs, not deliverables for their own sake.
about.label: About al‑Kindi
about.lead: A small, focused studio with roots in software and a strong foundation in design.
about.body1: We prefer clear scope, honest dialogue and work that can stand on its own without big words. Sometimes that means adding a feature; sometimes it means simplifying and removing noise.
about.body2: We're not chasing trends. We're here to help you build something useful, consistent and well‑made.
origin.label: Origin
origin.body1: al‑Kindi, the 9th‑century Baghdadi polymath, wrote on philosophy, music, optics — and invented cryptanalysis. The frequency analysis he laid out in Baghdad broke every cipher humanity had built; no system resistant to it would emerge for seven centuries. The same hand tuned an oud, translated Aristotle, and read enciphered letters.
origin.body2: The same 'al‑' is everywhere in Portugal, where we work — Alfama, Algarve, Alentejo, Almada — quiet traces of the Arabic‑speaking world he came from.
origin.body3: Eleven centuries later, his work on ciphers is the foundation of every smart contract we deploy. We borrowed the name in tribute.
team.label: Team
team.munevver.name: Münevver Aslan
team.munevver.bio: Münevver brings a multidisciplinary eye to every project — spanning brand systems, interaction design and the fine line between clarity and character. Born in Istanbul, now based between Lisbon and wherever the work takes her.
team.partner.name: Ferit Tunçer
team.partner.bio: The engineering half of al‑Kindi and founder of the studio. Ten years building production software with deep focus on Ethereum: smart contract development, security review, and gas‑sensitive protocol work. Cypherpunk by orientation, computer science by training. Based in Lisbon.
contact.label: Contact
contact.heading: Have a product to launch, a brand to refine or a service that needs better structure?
contact.sub: Tell us where you are and where you want to go — we'll help you design the path.
